method.lean: fixed-weight blend of four two-party leans — pres 0.40 (county-allocated presidential vote), house 0.20 (the district's own U.S. House general result), senate 0.20 (state's pooled Senate general races), statewide 0.20 (state's pooled governor / attorney general / secretary of state / state treasurer vote plus its state-legislature chamber totals over contested state-leg districts) — each measured as the Democratic two-party share of that race minus the same race's national share; weights renormalised over the sources present for each district-year; consensus optimum of an out-of-sample weight search (see README)

components.house: the district's own U.S. House general result from data/house/house_results_{year}.csv; winner votes missing in the article are reconstructed from percentage x district turnout, districts with no turnout fall back to a percentage-only share; one-sided races (top-two D-vs-D / R-vs-R, walkovers) dropped as uninformative
components.senate: the state's U.S. Senate general races (regular + special, pooled) from data/senate/; statewide, so uniform within a state
components.statewide: governor / attorney general / secretary of state / state treasurer races from data/statewide/ plus state senate + state house chamber totals from data/state_senate/ and data/state_house/ (contested state-leg districts only; no state-leg -> congressional-district crosswalk exists, so they enter as statewide sums); presidential-year coverage is partial — 10-12 gov states, exec offices parsed from 2016, state-leg 11-24 states before 2016 and 39-41 from 2020

method.allocation: whole counties: full weight; partial counties: allocated by geometric county-area shares (county_share_pct) normalised across claimant districts; at-large: entire jurisdiction
method.note_2012: Nov 2012 voted under the 2000s map (108th-112th Congress lines, as finally used incl. TX 2003 / GA 2006)
method.caveat: partial counties are area-weighted, not population-weighted; presidential leans for districts containing large shared counties are dampened toward the state mean — see votes_from_partial_pct; the 2010s crosswalk snapshot shows the map as first enacted (FL 2015 / NC 2016 & 2019 / PA 2018 court redraws are not reflected); Alaska has no borough-level presidential table before 2024, so AK-AL blends house + senate + statewide for 2004-2020; house leans carry candidate/incumbency effects the presidential ticket does not; statewide-office coverage is partial in presidential years (most states elect them in midterms), so the statewide component earns its 0.20 weight only where a race was actually on the ballot

source.county_boundaries: 2010 Census cartographic county boundaries (1:5m), eric.clst.org mirror of gz_2010_us_050_00_5m.json
source.projection: EPSG:5070 (NAD83 / Conus Albers Equal Area); both layers treated identically so area ratios are projection-consistent

mapping.snapshot_note: Cycle snapshots are taken at the END congress of each cycle so mid-decade court redraws are reflected; the 2020s snapshot includes the final post-2024 court-ordered redraws for AL / GA / LA / NC / NY.
mapping.classification_note: Full = county_frac >= 98% of the county's district-covered area; Partial = >= 2% of the county, or >= 4% of the district's own area (fragment rule for urban districts inside one large county).

event_notes.TX:2000s: Map reflects the 2003 Tom DeLay mid-decade redraw, in force for the 109th-112th Congresses (2006 court-drawn interim lines finalised by 2007 are included).
event_notes.TX:2020s: 2021 legislature-enacted map; reversed the 2000s move that had shifted Texarkana out of TX-01.
event_notes.AL:2020s: 2023 map invalidated by Allen v. Milligan; court-drawn additional majority-Black district (AL-02) used from the 2024 election.
event_notes.GA:2020s: 2023 legislature map; court-ordered Black-majority districts added from the 2024 election.
event_notes.LA:2020s: Callais-era litigation; a second majority-Black district (LA-06) drawn for the 2024 election.
event_notes.NC:2020s: October 2023 legislature map enacted for the 2024 election (NC-01/NC-03 boundaries changed).
event_notes.NY:2020s: 2023 map enacted by the Independent Redistricting Commission path for the 2024 election.
event_notes.PA:2010s: Snapshot is the 113th-Congress map; the 2018 Pennsylvania Supreme Court redraw used for 115th-117th is NOT shown.
event_notes.NC:2010s: Snapshot is the 113th-Congress map; 2016 and 2019 court redraws used later in the decade are NOT shown.
event_notes.VA:2010s: Snapshot is the 113th-Congress map; the 2020 redistricting commission map is NOT shown.
event_notes.FL:2010s: Snapshot is the 113th-Congress map; 2015-16 court-ordered redraws (Fair Districts) are NOT shown.
